title: estate slots grant cannot pin a grant to a commit, and its arguments carry no help
body:
`intent estate slots grant` takes `[SUBJECT] [TEXT]` and `--lane` only. A controller that has confirmed a commit itself cannot pin the grant to it; the pin is held only at `slots start`, against the ask's own set. Grant's `[SUBJECT]` and `[TEXT]` arguments carry no help text.

Reported by agentic-engineering-vc on hv's word in its window (AE hv decision 106 (5)), relayed by devbin-vc (~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/20261119/intent-desk-defects.md, checked there on 3.4.0). Re-read by intent-vc on 2026-11-22 against main at 5f2da89ca (3.5.1): still live.
